jobs.title: Product Engineer - AI Finance
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software. Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise. As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models. jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description: At Cogstate , we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life. Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials. Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving. At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it. That’s why we’re seeking a Financial Analyst, responsible for working with the 3 existing Clinical Trials Finance Team members to support the delivery of goals and objectives of the Clinical Trials division within Cogstate. The role is required to be a subject matter expert in the pricing of all external request for proposals (RFP’s), supporting Project Managers with the financial aspects of their projects and for creating internal monthly financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Create Pricing for customer proposals based on RFP’s received, internal inputs, and within company approved standards. jobs.description: Seit über 75 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir bei HUMMEL innovative Lösungen in der Verbindungstechnik – von hochwertigen Komponenten für die Elektrotechnik bis hin zu modernem Zubehör für Heizungs- und Trinkwassersysteme. Als unabhängiges, mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Denzlingen stehen wir für Qualität, Präzision und Verlässlichkeit. Heute sind wir international vernetzt mit 9 Niederlassungen und einem starken globalen Partnernetzwerk. Rund 600 engagierte Mitarbeitende bringen bei uns täglich ihr Know-how und ihre Ideen ein – in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Wegen, flachen Hierarchien und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Werde auch du Teil des erfolgreichen HUMMEL-Teams und bewirb dich jetzt für unseren Standort in Denzlingen. Aufgaben Bei uns geht es nicht nur um Technik – sondern darum, Lösungen zu schaffen, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen. In deiner Rolle als Financial Analyst (m/w/d) arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich und eng mit deinem Team zusammen. Konkret bedeutet das: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung des globalen Monatsreportings und analysierst relevante Finanz- und Unternehmenskennzahlen. Du wirkst in der operativen Buchhaltung mit, insbesondere bei der Verbuchung von Geschäftsvorfällen, im Mahnwesen sowie bei Zahlungsläufen. Du bereitest Kostenstellengespräche vor und nach und erstellst Soll-Ist- sowie Abweichungsanalysen. Du arbeitest an internationalen Finance-Projekten mit und unterstützt die Harmonisierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung von Finanzprozessen. Du erstellst und entwickelst Projekt- und Managementreportings kontinuierlich weiter. Du erstellst statistische Meldungen und sorgst für deren fristgerechte Einreichung bei externen Stellen. jobs.title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) Finance
jobs.description: Die AVS Services GmbH hat ihren Hauptsitz in Leverkusen. Sie ist ein führender Anbieter von Verkehrssicherheitslösungen in Deutschland und ist auf die Verkehrssicherung sowie das Verkehrsmanagement in Baustellenbereichen auf Autobahnen, Bundes- und Schnellstraßen sowie für urbane Verkehrsnetze spezialisiert. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%.
